runtimeSettings.title: Litlhophiso tsa Nako ea ho Ruta
runtimeSettings.description: Lokisa kamoo Novera e laolang le ho leka hape li-server tsa MCP.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Nako e phahameng ea ho emela karabo ea MCP pele u qeta nako.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputChars: Litlhaku tse hlahisoang ke lisebelisoa tse ngata
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Sephetho sa sesebelisoa se telele ka ho fetesisa se bolokiloeng moqoqong. Ntho efe kapa efe e fetileng e hlophisitsoe 'me e tšoauoa e le e fokolitsoeng, kahoo sephetho se le seng se seholo se ke ke sa felisa moelelo oa mohlala. E behe ho 0 ho boloka liphetho li feletse.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRouting: Smart MCP lisebelisoa tsa ho tsamaisa lisebelisoa
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Ha e laelitsoe, Novera e khetha li-server tsa MCP tse loketseng pele e kenya lisebelisoa. Koala hore u lule u kenya lenane la MCP ka botlalo.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModel: Sebelisa mofuta o ikhethileng oa ho tsamaisa litsela
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Ha mokhoa o bohlale o butsoe, tsamaisa mohato oa ho tsamaisa ka mofuta o ikhethileng (hangata o le o monyane) ho fapana le mofuta oa moqoqo. Koala hore u lule u sebelisa mokhoa oa moqoqo o sebetsang bakeng sa ho tsamaisa.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Khetha mofani oa thepa le mohlala sebakeng se le seng. Ke mefuta e bobebe feela e thathamisitsoeng e le hore litsela li lule li potlakile ebile li le theko e tlase.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Ha ho mefuta e bobebe e fumanehang. Kenya mofuta o monyane kapa u lokise likonopo tsa API ho Mefuta.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptySearch: Ha ho tse tšoanang bakeng sa "{{query}}".
